meta.funnel: Google Ads → weight-loss landing pages → book consultation → thank-you
assumptions: Section map inferred from scroll depth: hero 0-20, proof 20-45, testimonials 45-70, pricing/FAQ 70-90, CTA 90+.
Value per conversion assumed INR 1,200 (editable; only affects the ₹ north-star).
Ad-spend / cost-per-conversion NOT connected — CPL ranks on conversion volume; creative-asset signals shown as schema-ready, not fabricated.
Multi-tenant + roles + apply-actions are scaffolded (human-in-the-loop); a second workspace is shown locked as a demo of isolation.

recommendations.title: Retarget returning visitors — they convert far higher
recommendations.because: returned (2+ visits) convert 2.66× those who single visit (17.2% vs 6.5%). 787 visitors sit on the losing side.
recommendations.do: Build a lookalike of the converting segment + shift budget toward it.

finding.action_rule: Build a lookalike of the converting segment + shift budget toward it.

artifact: Seed segment (converting behavior):
returning (2+ visits) AND reached_testimonials AND intent_score ≥ 75
(10 visitors match)
• Build a lookalike; add a retargeting audience of past-hero non-converters.
• Shift 15% budget from broad prospecting to this audience.
draft.apply_via: Google Ads API: userList.create + campaign budget update.

recommendations.title: Compress the hero — get value prop + proof into the first screen
recommendations.because: scrolled past the hero (≥20%) convert 4.09× those who hero-only (<20%) (15.6% vs 3.8%). 604 visitors sit on the losing side. Most paid traffic bounces at ~17-19% scroll — proof sits below the fold.
recommendations.do: Reorder / redesign the section — move proof + testimonials above the fold.

finding.action_rule: Reorder / redesign the section — move proof + testimonials above the fold.
finding.note: Most paid traffic bounces at ~17-19% scroll — proof sits below the fold.

artifact: CURRENT order:  hero → proof → testimonials → pricing/FAQ → CTA
NEW order:      hero (compressed) → proof → testimonials → CTA → pricing/FAQ
• Cut hero height ~40%; surface 2 testimonials + trust badges above the fold.
• Add a sticky 'Book free consultation' CTA on mobile.
• Expected: move 604 hero-bouncers toward the 4.09× cohort.
draft.apply_via: Export to Progen LP repo (progen-landing-pages) as a diff PR.

recommendations.because: diet clinics convert 3.49× those who weight loss treatment price (13.3% vs 3.8%). 131 visitors sit on the losing side. Same budget, very different conversion rates by query.
recommendations.do: Add negative keywords for the low-intent query + reallocate its budget to the winner.

finding.action_rule: Add negative keywords for the low-intent query + reallocate its budget to the winner.
